lines.en: label sarainvite1:
I tap on Sara’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Sara 的名字，等她接起来。

lines.en: I figure that the two of us know each other well enough at this point that it won’t really be weird for me to invite her over.
lines.zh: 我想，我俩现在也算是够熟了，请她来家里应该不至于太奇怪。

lines.en: Sure, I don't really know what Ami will think about an older woman randomly showing up at the house, but I’m the one who’s paying the bills.
lines.zh: 当然，我不知道 Ami 会怎么想「有个年长女人突然出现在家里」这件事，但账单是我付的。

lines.en: I’ll invite whoever I want over.
lines.zh: 我想请谁回来就请谁。

lines.en: This is what it means to be an adult.
lines.zh: 这就是成年人的意思。

lines.en: if invitetip == False:
call invitetip from _call_invitetip_2
scene noonsky
: Hellooo~ Sensei?
lines.zh: : 喂———~ Sensei？

lines.en: : Hey. What are you doing tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。今晚在干嘛？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just drinking half of my stock since no one else ever wants to show up.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。反正也没别人愿意来，就把库存喝掉一半呗。

lines.en: : Do you want to come over and keep me company?
lines.zh: : 要不要过来陪陪我？

lines.en: : Actually, I was wondering if you wanted to come over for a change.
lines.zh: : 其实我在想，这次换你来我家怎么样。

lines.en: : What, you mean like, to your place?
lines.zh: : 什么，你是说……去你家？

lines.en: : Is that really okay?
lines.zh: : 真的可以吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I come to the bar all the time. I figure it’s about time for you to see where I live.
lines.zh: : 当然。我老往你酒吧跑，你也该看看我住哪儿了。

lines.en: : Oh my God! Yeah! Definitely!
lines.zh: : 我的天！好！当然要去！

lines.en: : I-I’ll have Sana take over for me and I'll head right over.
lines.zh: : 我——我让 Sana 替我看着店，然后马上过去。

lines.en: : I’m so excited. I was starting to think you were ashamed of me and didn’t want your [niece] knowing that we hang out and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我好兴奋。我还以为你嫌弃我，不想让你 [niece] 知道我俩经常一起玩什么的。

lines.en: : Am I sleeping over? Do I need an overnight bag?
lines.zh: : 我要过夜吗？需要带个过夜包吗？

lines.en: : Hey, now. Slow down.
lines.zh: : 喂喂，慢点。

lines.en: : It’s one thing to invite you over, but I’m pretty sure Ami would kill both of us in the middle of the night if you stayed over your first time here.
lines.zh: : 请你来做客是一回事，可你要是第一次来就过夜，我敢肯定 Ami 半夜会把我俩都杀了。

lines.en: : Oooooh, right. Right. Okay!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，对。对。好吧！

lines.en: : Can you send me the address? I’ll meet you over there as soon as I can.
lines.zh: : 你能把地址发给我吗？我尽快过去找你。

lines.en: : Sure thing. See you soon.
lines.zh: : 没问题。待会儿见。

lines.en: I hang up the phone and quickly type out my address before sending it to Sara.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，飞快地打好地址发给 Sara。

lines.en: It will be her first time seeing the place and I’m pretty sure Ami will be around tonight.
lines.zh: 这会是她第一次来这儿，而我敢肯定 Ami 今晚会在家。

lines.en: All I can really hope is that the two of them manage to get along.
lines.zh: 我唯一能指望的，就是她俩能相处得来。

lines.en: scene black
Sara, I’m obviously not worried about.
lines.zh: Sara 那边我显然不担心。

lines.en: She has a daughter, so she clearly knows (At least to some extent) how to deal with [young_girls].
lines.zh: 她自己有个女儿，所以显然知道（至少在某种程度上）怎么应付[young_girls]。

lines.en: Ami, on the other hand...
lines.zh: Ami 那边就不好说了……

lines.en: Well. I guess I’ll just have to wait and see.
lines.zh: 唉。看来只能等着瞧了。

lines.en: : Come in.
lines.zh: : 进来吧。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite1
I’m in the kitchen when Sara lets herself in.
lines.zh: Sara 自己开门进来的时候，我正在厨房。

lines.en: She immediately comes to meet me at the counter and props herself up on it using her elbows.
lines.zh: 她立刻走到吧台边找我，用胳膊肘撑在台面上。

lines.en: She doesn’t say anything, just smiles at me and waits for me to talk.
lines.zh: 她什么也没说，只是冲我笑着，等我开口。

lines.en: : Uhh, welcome to my house, I guess.
lines.zh: : 呃……欢迎来我家，大概吧。

lines.en: : Thank you so much for having me.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢你邀请我来。

lines.en: : What are you making me for dinner?
lines.zh: : 你今晚给我做什么晚饭？

lines.en: : ...I'm sorry. What?
lines.zh: : ……抱歉。你说什么？

lines.en: : You are making me dinner, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 你总要给我做晚饭吧？

lines.en: : I...didn’t plan on it?
lines.zh: : 我……没打算做啊？

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite2
: You invited a girl over and aren’t going to make her dinner? I thought your manners were better than this.
lines.zh: : 你把女生请到家里来，却不给她做晚饭？我还以为你比这有礼貌呢。

lines.en: : Trust me, you wouldn’t want me making you dinner in the first place. I can barely cook an egg.
lines.zh: : 相信我，你根本不会想让我给你做饭。我连个鸡蛋都煎不好。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite3
: It looks like the two of us would have to order out quite often if we ever moved in together.
lines.zh: : 看来要是我俩哪天住在一起，得经常叫外卖了。

lines.en: : A - It’s way too early to be talking about moving in together.
lines.zh: : 一、现在谈同居还太早了。

lines.en: : B - You can’t cook either?
lines.zh: : 二、你也不会做饭？

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite4
: I can use a microwave pretty well.
lines.zh: : 我用微波炉用得可好了。

lines.en: : Sana ate nothing but chicken nuggets until she was seven, so I’ve memorized the cooking times for like twenty different brands.
lines.zh: : Sana 到七岁为止只吃鸡块，所以我背下了大概二十个不同品牌的加热时间。

lines.en: : I don’t know whether to be impressed or abhorred that you would allow your child to live off of nothing but microwaved chicken nuggets for so long.
lines.zh: : 你居然让孩子靠微波炉鸡块活了那么久，我不知道该佩服还是该惊悚。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite3
: Hey, she turned out okay, didn’t she?
lines.zh: : 嘿，她不是长得好好的吗？

lines.en: : I have the cutest daughter in all of Kumon-mi. And she’s somehow still super tiny despite her diet.
lines.zh: : 我有全 Kumon-mi 最可爱的女儿。而且明明吃成那样，她还是小小一只。

lines.en: : Well that’s obviously genetic. You’re pretty small yourself.
lines.zh: : 那显然是遗传。你自己也挺小的。

lines.en: : I’m fun-size. Easier to lift up and have your way with.
lines.zh: : 我是「迷你装」。更容易被举起来、任你摆布。

lines.en: : Are you already trying to seduce me? You’ve been here for five minutes.
lines.zh: : 你这就开始勾引我了？你才来了五分钟。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite5
: Worried your [niece] will come home and catch us?
lines.zh: : 怕你 [niece] 回来撞见我们？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah. She’ll be home any minute.
lines.zh: : 有点，对。她随时都可能回来。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite6
: Oh, how is she going to feel about this, by the way?
lines.zh: : 哦对了，她会怎么想这件事？

lines.en: : Won’t it be a little weird for her to come home and see you talking to some woman she’s never met before?
lines.zh: : 她一回家就看见你和一个从没见过的女人说话，会不会有点怪？

lines.en: : I’m sure you at least warned her in advance, right?
lines.zh: : 你总该提前跟她打过招呼了吧？

lines.en: : Nahh. Ami is mature enough to handle being thrown into the fire every now and then.
lines.zh: : 没。Ami 够成熟了，偶尔被扔进火里也扛得住。

lines.en: : She’ll probably freeze at first, but I’m sure she’ll warm up to you in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 她一开始大概会僵住，但我敢肯定她很快就会跟你熟起来的。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite7
: You really think so?
lines.zh: : 你真这么想？

lines.en: : Maybe I’ll have a second daughter before I know it?...
lines.zh: : 说不定我不知不觉就要有第二个女儿了？……

lines.en: : That...is not what I meant.
lines.zh: : 那……不是我的意思。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite8
: I’m home!
lines.zh: : 我回来了！

lines.en: The sound of the door unlocking quickly breaks up our conversation as we fix our eyes on the door.
lines.zh: 门锁转动的声音很快打断了我俩的对话，我们同时把目光投向门口。

lines.en: The moment of truth approaches.
lines.zh: 关键时刻到了。

lines.en: : Oh God. That’s her, right? Do I look okay?
lines.zh: : 天哪。那就是她吧？我看起来还行吗？

lines.en: : Why are you more focused on impressing my [niece] than me?
lines.zh: : 为什么你比起讨好我，更在意讨好我 [niece]？

lines.en: : I already know you like me. I need to make her like me next and I’ll be basically guaranteed a spot in this family.
lines.zh: : 我已经知道你喜欢我了。接下来我得让她也喜欢我，那我在这个家里的位置基本就稳了。

lines.en: : Sara, that isn’t how families work.
lines.zh: : Sara，家庭不是这么运作的。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite9
: Welcome home.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来。

lines.en: : Hi! You must be Ami. Your [uncle]’s said so much about you.
lines.zh: : 你好！你一定就是 Ami。你 [uncle] 跟我说了好多你的事。

lines.en: No, I don’t think I have.
lines.zh: 不，我觉得我没有。

lines.en: : How was[school]?
lines.zh: : [school]怎么样？

lines.en: : I think I might have opened a door to the wrong dimension.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我可能打开了一扇通往错误维度的门。

lines.en: : I’m going to leave and come back in and I’m sure everything will go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 我出去再进来一次，一切肯定就恢复正常了。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite10
: That...didn’t go as I expected it to.
lines.zh: : 这……和我预想的不一样。

lines.en: : It went exactly as I expected it to.
lines.zh: : 和我预想的完全一样。

lines.en: : I...I’m home!
lines.zh: : 我……我回来了！

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite11
: It...it's still here...
lines.zh: : 它……它还在……

lines.en: : It?
: Hi again~
lines.zh: : 又见面了~

lines.en: : Welcome home.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来。

lines.en: : What...what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 怎……怎么回事？

lines.en: : Why is there...a woman...in our house?...
lines.zh: : 为什么我们家里……有个女人？……

lines.en: : I invited her over. She’s a friend of mine.
lines.zh: : 我请她来的。她是我朋友。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite12
: It’s nice to finally meet you, Ami! You’re very pretty.
lines.zh: : 终于见到你了，Ami！你真漂亮。

lines.en: : ...Thank you.
: Good. Keep saying things like that. She loves compliments.
lines.zh: : 很好。多说点这种话。她最爱听人夸了。

lines.en: : You take care of your [uncle] too, don’t you? That’s very impressive for a girl your age.
lines.zh: : 你也把你 [uncle] 照顾得很好吧？你这年纪能这样真了不起。

lines.en: : I wish my daughter would take care of me more.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我女儿也能多照顾照顾我。

lines.en: : D...Daughter?...
: Oh, right. This is Sana’s mom.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。这位是 Sana 的妈妈。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite13
: S-Sana’s mom?!
lines.zh: : S-Sana 的妈妈？！

lines.en: : Why is Sana’s mom in our kitchen?!
lines.zh: : 为什么 Sana 的妈妈会在我们家厨房？！

lines.en: : Is Sana here too?!
lines.zh: : Sana 也在吗？！

lines.en: : How many girls are you hiding from me?!
lines.zh: : 你到底还瞒着我藏了多少女生？！

lines.en: : I’m not hiding any. Sana’s mom, Sara, is right in front of you.
lines.zh: : 我一个都没藏。Sana 的妈妈 Sara，就在你面前。

lines.en: : I hope I’m not intruding or anything.
lines.zh: : 希望我没有打扰到什么。

lines.en: : You are! Get out of my house!
lines.zh: : 你就是！滚出我家！

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite14
: Wow...I had a feeling you two were close but I didn’t realize you were this close.
lines.zh: : 哇……我就觉得你俩关系很近，没想到近到这种程度。

lines.en: : It’s like she’s afraid of women.
lines.zh: : 她好像很怕女人似的。

lines.en: : S...Sensei...what is this?...
lines.zh: : S……Sensei……这是什么情况？……

lines.en: : She even calls you Sensei?
lines.zh: : 她居然还叫你 Sensei？

lines.en: : You haven’t brainwashed her, have you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会给她洗脑了吧？

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite15
: I...I’m not brainwashed! I just don’t want anyone stealing my [uncle] away from me!
lines.zh: : 我……我才没有被洗脑！我只是不想让任何人把我的 [uncle] 抢走！

lines.en: : Aww...You really love him, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 哎呀……你真的很爱他，对吧？

lines.en: I think love is a bit of an understatement, personally...
lines.zh: 我个人觉得，用「爱」来形容都有点轻了……

lines.en: : O-Of course I do! He’s my [uncle]! He’s all I have!
lines.zh: : 当——当然爱！他是我的 [uncle]！他是我的全部！

lines.en: : Don’t worry, dear. I won’t steal him from you.
lines.zh: : 别担心，亲爱的。我不会把他从你身边抢走的。

lines.en: : The two of us were just chatting and he wanted me to meet you.
lines.zh: : 我俩只是聊了聊天，他想让我见见你。

lines.en: : In fact, when he invited me over, he specifically said, “I need to prove to you that my [niece] is the cutest girl in all of Kumon-mi.”
lines.zh: : 事实上，他请我过来的时候特地说了句：「我得向你证明，我的 [niece] 是全 Kumon-mi 最可爱的女孩。」

lines.en: : Now, being the mother of a cute girl, I couldn’t help but dispute it. But now that I’ve seen you in person...
lines.zh: : 作为一位可爱女孩的母亲，我本来忍不住想反驳。可现在亲眼见到你……

lines.en: : I...I think I might have to agree.
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得我可能得同意了。

lines.en: In an incredibly risky and rather impressive move, Sara swoops in for the kill and appeals to Ami’s weakest point- validation.
lines.zh: 在一记极其冒险却相当漂亮的招式里，Sara 直取要害，攻向 Ami 最薄弱的地方——被认可。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite16
: You...
: You don’t mean that...
lines.zh: : 你不是真心的吧……

lines.en: : No, no. I really do.
lines.zh: : 不，不。我是真心的。

lines.en: : ...Well, thank you.
: But...you won’t say anything to Sana...right?...
lines.zh: : 不过……你不会跟 Sana 说吧……对吧？……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t want her to feel bad...
lines.zh: : 我不想让她难过……

lines.en: : She’s...really cute too...
lines.zh: : 她……也很可爱……

lines.en: : Of course not. I’ll keep my opinion to myself for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。我会把这个看法永远烂在肚子里。

lines.en: : I just hope you can find it in your heart to forgive me for showing up unannounced...
lines.zh: : 我只希望你能大发慈悲，原谅我不请自来……

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite17
: Well...I guess it’s okay as long as I can supervise you two...
lines.zh: : 嗯……只要我能监督你俩，那就没问题……

lines.en: : What? Why do we need a supervisor? We’re adults.
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么我们需要被人监督？我们是成年人啊。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite18
: I’m not a kid, you know! I’m old enough to know what two consenting adults do when they’re alone together!
lines.zh: : 我才不是小孩！我已经大到知道两个你情我愿的成年人独处时会干些什么了！

lines.en: : Unfortunately for me, I can’t imagine your [uncle] would ever consent to doing anything when his heart has already been taken by you.
lines.zh: : 可惜对我来说，既然你 [uncle] 的心已经被你占满了，我实在想象不出他还会答应做什么。

lines.en: Okay. This is no longer risky. It’s reckless.
lines.zh: 好了。这已经不是冒险了。这是胡来。

lines.en: This is a dangerous can of worms you’re opening, Sara.
lines.zh: Sara，你正在打开一罐危险的虫子。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite19
: S...Sensei...
lines.zh: : S……Sensei……

lines.en: : You’d really...choose me over...someone as pretty as her?...
lines.zh: : 你真的……会选我，而不是……像她这么漂亮的人？……

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite20
: Did I do well? I did well, right?
lines.zh: : 我表现得不错吧？我干得漂亮，对吧？

lines.en: scene black
I sigh to myself and take a seat at the dining room table.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，在餐桌旁坐下。

lines.en: Sara follows suit and, after taking a minute to collect herself, Ami does as well...
lines.zh: Sara 也跟着坐下；Ami 缓了一分钟后，也坐了下来……

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite21
: Thanks for not kicking me out, Ami. I really hope the two of us can get along.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你没把我赶出去，Ami。我真心希望我俩能好好相处。

lines.en: : Um...this still feels a little weird for me...
lines.zh: : 嗯……这对我来说还是有点怪……

lines.en: : It’s not exactly...common for someone Sensei’s age to join us at the dinner table.
lines.zh: : 像 Sensei 这个年纪的人坐到我们的餐桌旁，实在算不上……寻常。

lines.en: : Especially when there is no dinner...
lines.zh: : 尤其是在没有晚饭的情况下……

lines.en: : I take it you do all of the cooking around here?
lines.zh: : 这么说，平时饭都是你做的？

lines.en: : I thought Sensei was going to cook dinner for us tonight. I was totally surprised when I found out he wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 我还以为今晚 Sensei 会给我们做晚饭呢。发现他不做的时候我可惊讶了。

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite22
: Sensei? My Sensei? Cooking dinner?
lines.zh: : Sensei？我家 Sensei？做晚饭？

lines.en: : Never in a billion years. He needs me.
lines.zh: : 十亿年都不可能。他离不开我。

lines.en: : I want to be offended by that but it’s really hard when it’s 100%% true.
lines.zh: : 我本来想生气的，可这话说得 100%% 正确，实在气不起来。

lines.en: : Now...I don’t mean to impose, but maybe one day you and I could make dinner together, Ami?
lines.zh: : 那么……我不想多打扰，不过说不定哪天你和我可以一起做饭呢，Ami？

lines.en: : Wait...but I thought you said you couldn’t-
lines.zh: : 等等……可你不是说你不会——

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite23
: T-Together?...
: But...what about Sana? Shouldn’t you be making dinner with her instead?
lines.zh: : 可……那 Sana 呢？你不该是和她一起做饭吗？

lines.en: : Am I just being ignored now?
lines.zh: : 现在我是被彻底无视了吗？

lines.en: Sara seems to be taking this family-infiltration mission seriously. She’s not even acknowledging me anymore.
lines.zh: Sara 似乎把这次「渗透家庭」的任务当真了。她连理都不理我了。

lines.en: And she’s almost completely won over Ami.
lines.zh: 而且她几乎已经把 Ami 完全拿下了。

lines.en: What is happening right now?
lines.zh: 现在到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : What if Sana comes over as well?
lines.zh: : 要是 Sana 也来呢？

lines.en: : In fact, what if we leave Sensei out of it entirely and have a little girls’ night in? That sounds fun, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，要不我们干脆把 Sensei 排除在外，办个小小的女生之夜？听起来很有意思吧？

lines.en: : The blonde one can come too. Ayane, I think?
lines.zh: : 那个金发的也可以来。Ayane，对吧？

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite24
: R-Really?! Just us girls?!
lines.zh: : 真——真的吗？！只有我们女生？！

lines.en: : Of course! No boys allowed.
lines.zh: : 当然！男生不许进。

lines.en: : That means...I won’t have to worry about anyone stealing Sensei!
lines.zh: : 也就是说……我就不用担心有人把 Sensei 抢走了！

lines.en: Is Ami unaware that there are girls in other locations? One of them could easily steal me if she’s not looking.
lines.zh: Ami 是不知道别的地方也有女生吗？只要她一不留神，随便哪个都能把我抢走。

lines.en: : Yes! Yes! I want to do that!
lines.zh: : 好！好！我要办！

lines.en: : What was your name again?
lines.zh: : 你叫什么来着？

lines.en: : I wasn’t paying attention the first time I heard it because I already decided I hated you. But I’ve changed my mind!
lines.zh: : 我第一次听的时候没认真听，因为那时候我已经决定讨厌你了。可现在我改变主意了！

lines.en: scene sarafirstinvite25
: It’s...Sara. Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 我叫……Sara。哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Sara...Sara...Okay. That’s easy to remember.
lines.zh: : Sara……Sara……好。这个好记。

lines.en: : I promise not to tell Sana that you think I’m cuter than her. That’ll be a secret between you and me.
lines.zh: : 我保证不告诉 Sana，你觉得我比她可爱。这是我们俩之间的秘密。

lines.en: : Thanks. I really appreciate that...
lines.zh: : 谢了。我真的很感激……

lines.en: scene black
The two of them carry on their conversation and ignore me all the way until night falls.
lines.zh: 她俩就这么聊了下去，一路无视我，直到天黑。

lines.en: I knew inviting Sara over would spark up some sort of confrontation with Ami, but I had no idea it would mean essentially locking me out of every discussion for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: 我知道请 Sara 过来多少会和 Ami 起冲突，但没想到结果是我被彻底排除在今天剩下的每一场对话之外。

lines.en: But oh well.
lines.zh: 不过算了。

lines.en: I guess this just means it will be easier to invite Sara over in the future.
lines.zh: 我想这至少意味着，以后再请 Sara 过来会容易些。

lines.en: Sara winds up calling a cab to drive her home once it gets dark out.
lines.zh: 天黑之后，Sara 最后叫了辆出租车回家。

lines.en: I offer to walk her back myself but she shrugs it off when she wants to stay on good terms with my [niece].
lines.zh: 我提出自己送她回去，可她为了和我 [niece] 保持良好关系，婉拒了。

lines.en: It’s strange, though.
lines.zh: 不过说来也怪。

lines.en: Even though the two of us didn’t get to spend much time actually talking to one another, I still feel like I know Sara a lot better than I did before...
lines.zh: 虽然我俩其实没怎么真正说上话，我还是觉得自己比以前更了解 Sara 了……

$ sarainvite1 = True

lines.zh: Sara 的好感度提升到了 [sara_love]!

label invitetip:
Welcome to the invite over tooltip!
lines.zh: 欢迎查看「邀请来家」的说明！

lines.en: In Lessons in Love, you have the option to invite characters over during nights to increase your level with them in either affection or lust.
lines.zh: 在《Lessons in Love》里，你可以选择在夜里邀请角色来家里，以提升自己与她们的好感或欲望等级。

lines.en: Before you’re able to choose, though, you must play through both of the respective character’s invite-over introductory events.
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，你必须先打通该角色的两个「邀请来家」引导事件。

lines.en: The first one will be meant to introduce them to your house-
lines.zh: 第一个用来把她们介绍进你的家——

lines.en: And the second one will be reserved for performing sex acts with/on them!
lines.zh: 而第二个则专门留给和她们做爱！

lines.en: After that, you’ll be able to choose between affection or lust each time you invite them over, and gain a bonus of 3 points in whichever stat you decide on.
lines.zh: 在那之后，每次邀请她们过来时你都能在好感或欲望之间选择，并在你选定的那项上获得 3 点加成。

lines.en: You can even change the outfits they wear during the invite-over animations based on how high your affection or lust level is with them!
lines.zh: 你甚至可以根据自己和她们的好感或欲望等级，更换「邀请来家」动画中她们穿的服装！

lines.en: Invite over events will be colored light blue in the event tracker, so you’ll always know when a new one is available.
lines.zh: 「邀请来家」事件在事件追踪器里会标成浅蓝色，所以你随时都能知道什么时候有新事件可玩。

lines.en: More are sure to pop up over time.
lines.zh: 以后肯定还会陆续增加。

lines.en: Since I suppose that’s all you really need to know for now, I’ll let you get back to the game!
lines.zh: 我想你现在需要知道的就这些了，那就放回游戏里继续玩吧！

lines.en: Thanks as always for playing!
lines.zh: 一如既往感谢你的游玩！

lines.en: $ invitetip = True
